integrity: The food-total constraint and model equations are taken directly from the primary source.
The corrected threshold follows from an exact characteristic-polynomial calculation and cubic Routh-Hurwitz inequalities.
The counterexample is replayed with exact rational arithmetic and uses strictly positive parameters.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the disease-free equilibrium and local invasion threshold only for the listeriosis-only subsystem.
The critical cases \(p_f=\alpha_4F\) and \(\mathcal R_F=1\) are nonhyperbolic and are not classified nonlinearly here.
No corrected endemic-equilibrium or global bifurcation theorem is claimed.
title: The ready-to-eat food reservoir shifts the listeriosis invasion threshold
